title: RTL Queries
description: Learn to find elements with RTL queries.

data.text: **Queries** are the methods RTL provides to find elements on the page. Choosing the right query helps make your tests accessible and resilient.

items: getBy – Returns element or throws error
findBy – Returns promise for async elements

data.title: Query Examples
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Choose queries that reflect how users find elements.
